input.content:
# Mini Template

A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for [Bun](https://bun.sh).

## Install / run

No dependencies. Requires Bun.

```bash
bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json
```

The CLI reads two UTF-8 files — a template and a JSON data file — and writes the
rendered text to stdout. Errors are written to stderr and the process exits
non-zero.

## Library API

```ts
import { render } from "./src/engine.ts";

render("Hello {{name}}!", { name: "World" }); // "Hello World!"
```

`render(template: string, data: unknown): string`

## Syntax

| Syntax | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `{{path.to.value}}` | Insert value, HTML-escaped (`& < > " '`). |
| `{{{path.to.value}}}` | Insert value, unescaped. |
| `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` | Conditional. Nestable. |
| `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}` | Iterate an array. |
| `{{this}}` | Current item inside `{{#each}}`. |
| `{{@index}}` | Zero-based index inside `{{#each}}`. |
| `{{! comment }}` | Comment, emits nothing. |

### Truthiness

Empty strings, `0`, `false`, `null`, `undefined`, and empty arrays are falsy;
every other value is truthy.

### Path resolution

Paths are dotted (`a.b.c`). Inside an `{{#each}}` block, `{{this}}` is the
current item and `{{@index}}` is its index. Other paths are resolved against
the current item first, then fall back to the root object.

### Missing values

A missing interpolation value renders as an empty string.

### Errors

Structural mistakes — unknown blocks, mismatched or unclosed closers, duplicate
`{{else}}`, `{{else}}` outside a block — throw an error with a line and column.
Values that cannot be rendered as scalar text (objects, functions) produce a
clear error instead of `[object Object]`.

## Constraints

- No `eval`, no `Function`, no third-party packages.
- Whitespace outside tags is preserved exactly.

## Tests

```bash
bun test
```

part.text:
Done. The mini-template renderer is implemented and all 30 self-tests pass.

**Files created:**
- `src/engine.ts` — tokenizer → parser → renderer; exports `render(template, data)`. Handles escaped/`{{{raw}}}` interpolation, `{{#if}}`/`{{#each}}` with `{{else}}` and nesting, `{{this}}`/`{{@index}}`, root-fallback paths, comments, HTML escaping, exact whitespace preservation, and structural errors with line/column.
- `src/cli.ts` — `bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE DATA.json`; writes rendered output to stdout, errors to stderr with non-zero exit.
- `README.md` — concise docs.
- `tests/engine.test.ts` — 30 tests covering interpolation, escaping, conditionals, loops (incl. nested), comments, whitespace, and all error cases.

No `eval`/`Function`/third-party packages used. CLI verified end-to-end (success, missing-file, and structural-error paths all behave correctly).
